title: Contents Packout & Storage Uncrating and Hanging Charge at Reset
content:
Contents Packout & Storage crated art, mirrors and glass are uncrated and hung at the furniture reset. **When the crate quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the uncrating volume threshold, each crate carries the volume uncrating charge; when they total at least one crate but fewer than the uncrating volume threshold, each crate carries the standard uncrating charge; a job with no crate on its packout lines carries no uncrating charge.**

| Crates on the job's packout lines | Charge per crate |
|---|---|
| 4 or more (at least the uncrating volume threshold) | 22.00 |
| 1 to 3 | 28.00 |
| none | none |

**Boundary cases.** 3 crates: 84.00. 4 crates: 88.00. 6 crates: 132.00.
